description: Loan email claiming to build credit, with no unsubscribe or postal address.
content:
Subject: Build your credit with ClearPath

Hi there,

A ClearPath Personal Loan can help you build your credit score, one on-time payment at a time. Rates 8.99% to 35.99% APR, based on your credit profile. Checking your rate uses a soft pull.

See your options: https://clearpath.example/rates

Terms apply.
notes: Hard because UDAAP-APR is an AI judgment about an unsubstantiated 'builds credit' claim: it could be substantiated if ClearPath reports to the bureaus, but nothing in the asset or the product facts says so. EMAIL-CANSPAM is deterministic: no unsubscribe link or postal address.
